notes.zh-CN: Claude API 新增每个账号独立的运行参数（自动压缩窗口、请求超时、关闭非必要网络、关闭遥测、精简系统提示），切换账号时写入对应账号的参数并重启 Claude，留空即删除该键使用默认值；Bot 对话输入区恢复模型与思考强度切换，CLI 也可在输入区切换（有消息的线程保留旧会话并新建，空线程原地切换）。macOS 为 universal 开发签名、未公证；Windows 安装包未签名；Android APK 为调试签名；iOS IPA 为开发签名，仅供团队已注册设备安装。
notes.en: Adds per-account Claude API runtime settings (auto-compact window, request timeout, disable nonessential traffic, disable telemetry, simple system prompt), written and applied when switching accounts, with an empty value removing that key; restores model and reasoning-level switching in a Bot's composer, plus CLI switching there (a thread with messages is kept while a fresh one starts, an empty thread changes in place). The universal macOS app is development-signed and unnotarized. Windows installers are unsigned. The Android APK is debug-signed. The development-signed iOS IPA installs on registered team devices.
